sum: GreenPower Motor Company Inc., together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and distributes electric vehicles in the United States and Canada. The company offers school bus, commercial goods, and commercial passenger line vehicles for delivery, public transit, school, vanpool, micro-transit, and shuttle sectors. It also engages in the electric bus sale and leasing; truck body manufacturing; and vehicle transportation. The company was founded in 2010 and is headquartered in Vancouver, Canada.
ceo: Mr. Fraser  Atkinson CPA, CA (Executive Chairman & CEO)
